The orchestra rehearsed the final movement twice before the concert. An old
clock above the market still chimes a little after each hour. Wind turbines on
the ridge turned slowly above the sleeping village. A careful reader will notice
that the second chapter starts mid sentence. A short letter from the council
thanked residents for their patience. The harbour office opens at seven and
closes when the last ferry has docked. The ledger lists every delivery, the
driver and the time of arrival. A quiet printer in the corner produced three
copies of the quarterly report. Students built a model lighthouse from paper,
glue and a tiny lamp. The weather station logs temperature, humidity and wind
